skill_concept: Recalling or deriving a complete Zork command walkthrough from game domain knowledge and writing the terminal's final output verbatim to a result file, with variant speedrun vs. max-score path selection.
verdict_reason: Both tasks require the same core knowledge — a Zork command walkthrough and the game's final output text — differing only in which ending string to write (max-score 350-point ending vs. speedrun minimal ending). A single skill encoding both path variants and the file-write mechanic covers both tasks completely.
weakest_link_reason: The max-score path requires knowing the full 350-point walkthrough rather than just the shortest route to an ending, making it marginally more demanding of complete game domain knowledge.
